description: Every x360Recover endpoint, plus the fleet-wide backup-health answers the API alone can't give — offline, joined, and agent-ready.

novel_features.name: Fleet backup-health sweep
novel_features.description: See every device fleet-wide whose latest backup job failed or went stale, grouped by client, in one command.

novel_features.name: Client backup-status rollup
novel_features.description: One row per client: devices total, failing, stale, RPO-breach, and AutoVerify-fail counts — the dashboard view MSPs build by hand today.

novel_features.name: Compliance evidence export
novel_features.description: Per-device compliance rows pairing newest restore-point age with AutoVerify boot-proof results and an RPO pass/fail verdict, exportable as CSV or JSON.

novel_features.name: RPO breach report
novel_features.description: Flag devices whose newest restore point is older than a recovery-point objective threshold, grouped by client.

novel_features.name: Per-client usage reconciliation
novel_features.description: Roll up protected-system counts and storage usage for every client into one exportable table for invoice reconciliation.

novel_features.name: Appliance-device assignment map
novel_features.description: Show which devices each appliance protects alongside each device's latest backup-job state.
